fails_if: the build refuses repeated rows only in the scope sources it loads per register, so a byte-identical repeated row of a support source (the Unika summary join) is accepted and the build completes
note: The Unika summary repeats VALUE's row. A support source prepares records the same way a scope source does, so the two rows share one record id, and the build refuses them with the same located code as a repeated Registerinformation row (step 1). The header is row 1, so the data rows are 2 and 3. Registerinformation itself delivers VALUE once.

sources.description: Register 1 delivers VALUE (member 1001) once, and its Unika summary row twice.
